name: @educateos/assessment-ci
description: EducateOS Assessment CI (roadmap E02): a deterministic evaluator SDK with pinned releases, built-in evaluators for writing, citations, spreadsheets, datasets and math, teacher-signed rubric releases, and durable idempotent assessment runs whose evidence reaches feedback only as labelled suggestions. Its `./durable-object-store` entry point is the runs' Durable Object SQLite store and queue. A library, not a deployable Worker.
